# FreeRTOS kernel provenance

The minimal kernel source set was imported from official FreeRTOS-Kernel V11.3.1, commit `3a22924e0a9ddbbc8b0758881c33b3422a5cc20d`. This cleanup moves the existing source set unchanged from `sw/freertos/kernel` to `third_party/freertos/kernel`.

The original MIT license is retained at `kernel/LICENSE.md`, together with all source file copyright headers. PtrocOS configuration, runtime and startup code live in `sw/ptrocos/os`.
